name: Task Date Links
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Undo entries that could not finish are kept and retried, even after a reload.
A back-fill of over 5,000 notes or 20,000 changed lines now stops before it writes, so its undo can finish.
tip: Add the property task-date-links: false to a note to keep date links out of it.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Task Date Links is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to keep your tasks in order.
